resolved_by: Amendment to Fed. R. Evid. 106 effective December 1, 2023, which codified that the rule operates over a hearsay objection, consistent with the Fifth Circuit's earlier decision in United States v. Portillo, 969 F.3d 144 (5th Cir. 2020).
issue: Does the rule of completeness in Federal Rule of Evidence 106 apply regardless of other rules of evidence, such as the rule against hearsay?
this_court: Rule 106 operates independently of the rule against hearsay, following United States v. Portillo, 969 F.3d 144, 176 (5th Cir. 2020).
quote: At the time of trial, there was a circuit split as to whether Rule 106 applied regardless of other rules of evidence, such as the rule against hearsay.
cite: United States v. Carpenter, 140 F.4th 733 (5th Cir. 2025)
